source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.7.4, printed pages 11-12.

blocks.text: First (pehli) electron affinity, ΔH°ₑₐ₁, woh enthalpy change (energy ki tabdeeli) hai jo standard conditions (tay shuda halaat) mein gaseous state ke 1 mole atoms mein 1 mole electrons jor kar 1 mole gas wale uni-negative (ek negative charge wale) ions banane par hota hai.

blocks.text_alt: Cl(g) + e⁻ → Cl⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −348.8 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Yeh woh energy hai jo gas halat ke 6.02 × 10²³ chlorine atoms ke Cl⁻(g) ions banne par release (bahar nikalti) hoti hai. Energy release hoti hai, is liye pehli electron affinity ke saath negative sign lagta hai.

Second (doosri) electron affinity, ΔH°ₑₐ₂, woh energy hai jo standard conditions mein 1 mole gas wale uni-negative ions mein electrons jor kar 1 mole gas wale 2− ions banane ke liye chahiye. Maslan neutral oxygen atom mein pehla electron jurne par 141 kJ mol⁻¹ energy release hoti hai.

blocks.text_alt: O(g) + e⁻ → O⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₁ = −141 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Lekin uni-negative O⁻ ion mein doosra electron jorne par 798 kJ mol⁻¹ energy absorb (jazb) hoti hai.

blocks.text_alt: O⁻(g) + e⁻ → O²⁻(g)   ΔH°ₑₐ₂ = +798 kJ mol⁻¹

blocks.text: Oxide ion (O²⁻) banne ka net (kul) enthalpy change pehli aur doosri electron affinity ko add (jama) kar ke nikalta hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Pehla electron neutral atom mein aata hai aur nucleus use kheenchta hai, is liye energy nikalti hai (−). Doosra electron pehle se negative O⁻ ion mein zabardasti dalna parta hai, jo use dhakelta hai, is liye energy deni parti hai (+).
Electron affinity par asar dalne wale factors
Elements ki electron affinity ki qeemat par asar dalne wale aham factors yeh hain:
Chhote atoms mein aane wale electron par nucleus ki attraction (kashish) zyada mazboot hoti hai. Is liye atom jitna chhota, us ki electron affinity utni zyada.
Element ka nuclear charge jitna zyada, us ka nucleus aane wale electron ko utni mazbooti se kheenchta hai. Is liye nuclear charge barhne se electron affinity bhi barhti hai.

Agar electron half-filled (aadhe bhare) subshell mein jure to electron affinity kam hoti hai. Group-15 (V-A) ke N aur P atoms ki electron affinity bohat kam hai, kyun ke in ke valence shell mein half-filled np orbitals hain (N = 2s² 2p³, P = 3s² 3p³). Yeh half-filled p-subshells bohat stable hain aur extra electron lena pasand nahi karte. Group-18 (VIII-A) ki noble gases ki configuration ns² np⁶ stable hai, is liye un ke atoms extra electron accept nahi karte; is ka saboot un ki positive 1st electron affinities hain.

blocks.prompt: Nitrogen ki electron affinity us ke chhote size ke bawajood itni kam kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ka 2p subshell bilkul aadha bhara (2p³) hai, jo ek stable arrangement hai. Naya electron kisi pehle se bhare orbital mein jore ki shakal mein jayega aur repulsion mehsoos karega, is liye nitrogen extra electron lene ki tendency (rujhan) kam rakhti hai aur us ki electron affinity bohat kam hai.

items: Pehli electron affinity: gas atoms ke ek mole ka ek mole electrons lena; energy release hoti hai, is liye negative (Cl −348.8, O −141 kJ mol⁻¹).
Doosri electron affinity positive hai (O⁻ se O²⁻: +798); O²⁻ ke liye kul +657 kJ mol⁻¹.
Chhote atom aur zyada nuclear charge par zyada; half-filled p subshells (N, P) par bohat kam; noble gases ki positive.
